title: Bind each acceptance to exactly one metric_id

facts.note: Acceptance/WMBT plan artifacts plus any test or artifact owned by a WMBT; a test-only or artifact-only placement/move activates the collocation duty without any acceptance or WMBT file change.
Authoring, editing or relocating an acceptance, a WMBT, or a WMBT's tests/artifacts.
Task produces or modifies acceptance criteria or WMBTs; not required for test-only/artifact-only placement, which activates via file_kind + operation.
Diff-level observer reading acceptance metric_id fields, WMBT dimension/lens_ref declarations, and the paths of a WMBT's acceptances, tests and artifacts relative to the owning WMBT.

fires: Planner authors a new acceptance under a WMBT
Planner edits an acceptance so its measured quantity or metric_id changes, or adds a second measure
Planner creates a WMBT or adds/changes its dimension or lens_ref, with no acceptance metric change
Planner places or moves a WMBT or its acceptances to a different location
Planner adds or moves only a test or artifact belonging to a WMBT, with no acceptance or WMBT file change
doesNotFire: Coder edits implementation code without touching acceptance/WMBT artifacts, WMBT-owned tests/artifacts, or their locations
Editing prose docs unrelated to acceptances or WMBTs
Editing the metric-mapping catalog itself (governed by planner.criteria.metric-mapping)

given: A planner is authoring or editing an acceptance or WMBT, or placing/moving a WMBT's acceptances, tests or artifacts.
when: The plan artifact, test or artifact is written or moved.
then: Bind each acceptance to exactly one metric_id from the dimension->metric_id table in planner.criteria.metric-mapping, matching its parent WMBT's dimension.
prefer: Take the metric_id from the metric-mapping row for the parent WMBT's dimension.
Write a separate acceptance for each additional measure.
Mandatory on every WMBT create/edit: declare exactly one dimension and one lens_ref.
Mandatory on every placement/move: put the WMBT, its acceptances, tests and artifacts in the WMBT's own location, so history and review of the WMBT stay in one place.
avoid: Mixed measures: one acceptance binding more than one metric_id.
A metric_id not in the metric-mapping table.
A WMBT without exactly one dimension and one lens_ref.
A WMBT's acceptances, tests or artifacts placed apart from the WMBT.
why: Keeping the WMBT, its acceptances, tests and artifacts together keeps their history and review cohesive.
evidence: Each acceptance declares exactly one metric_id, listed in the planner.criteria.metric-mapping dimension->metric_id table under the parent WMBT's dimension.
Each WMBT declares exactly one dimension and one lens_ref.
The WMBT, its acceptances, tests and artifacts live together in the WMBT's location.
verifier_detail: Metric catalog reference: metrics_catalog=conventions:criteria:metrics (source of valid metric_ids; see planner.criteria.metric-mapping).
Term metric_binding: each acceptance maps to exactly one metric_id, drawn from the dimension->metric_id table in planner.criteria.metric-mapping (no mixed measures).
Term lens_dimension_dependency: one dimension and one lens_ref per WMBT; check on every WMBT create/edit, not only when acceptance metrics change.

Term collocation: keep WMBT/acceptances/tests/artifacts together for cohesive history/review; check on every placement/move of any of these items, including test-only or artifact-only changes, by comparing the member's path with its owning WMBT's location.
audit: source statement: Bind each acceptance to one metric, respect the parent WMBT's single dimension/lens, and collocate WMBT + acceptances + tests + artifacts.

additions.text: Source bundles three obligations (metric binding, WMBT single dimension/lens, collocation). Primary kept in then; the other two remain mandatory here as positive steps prefer[2]/prefer[3] (mirrored in avoid[2]/avoid[3]) with activation covering WMBT-only and test/artifact-only placement work, and are proposed as planner.wmbt.single-dimension-lens and planner.wmbt.collocation.
additions.justification: Rule 2: one obligation per then, without weakening the other source obligations.

additions.text: Collocation is made operational as 'in the WMBT's own location' (members compared against the owning WMBT's path).
additions.justification: Reviewer flagged collocation as underdefined; this interprets the source's 'together' without inventing a specific directory layout.

additions.text: file_kind extended with test and artifact (WMBT-owned) so test-only/artifact-only placement activates collocation.
additions.justification: Auditor required fix; source collocation explicitly covers tests and artifacts.

additions.text: Editing the metric-mapping catalog itself is governed by planner.criteria.metric-mapping.
additions.justification: Clarifies activation boundary; adds no obligation.

additions.text: Write a separate acceptance for each additional measure.
additions.justification: Constructive restatement of 'no mixed measures'; no new obligation.
